priorityList: Maintain Instant Poison on your weapons and enter Stealth before combat.
Keep Blade Flurry active whenever 2 or more targets are present.
Spend Combo Points when you are at maximum minus 1 (usually 5 or 6 CP).
Use Dispatch as a finisher if Slice and Dice is not active to trigger Cut to the Chase.
Use Adrenaline Rush on cooldown, ideally when not already active.
Maintain Roll the Bones buffs; reroll if the buff expires or if you only have 1 buff active.
Use Keep it Rolling when you have 2 or more Roll the Bones buffs active to extend their duration.
Use Between the Eyes as your priority finisher whenever available.
Use Coup de Grace as a finisher or whenever the Disorienting Strikes buff is active.
Use Killing Spree as a finisher if other high-priority finishers are unavailable.
Use Dispatch as your default finisher to prevent overcapping Combo Points.
Cast Blade Rush on cooldown for AoE damage and energy generation.
Use Ambush when Audacity is active or when Hidden Opportunity allows its use.
Cast Pistol Shot only when Opportunity is active, prioritizing cases where you have max stacks or low Combo Points.
Use Vanish to trigger Hidden Opportunity and Ambush if you have no active Audacity or Opportunity procs.
